notes: Single source of truth. v3 (Oct 29 rebuild): structural invalidation stops under a 20% planned premium-loss CEILING (the old 20/12/10% time schedule is frozen in policy_old_2026-10-28.3.json for replay only), confirmed candle-close entries, skip bars with call+put signals, >= 2:1 planned reward/risk on BOTH the underlying and the option-dollar estimate, level-based T1, 10-min green stall exit, MACD momentum exit, 4 ideas/day + streak stop for main paper, flat by 15:25 ET. All new strategy logic is PAPER evaluation first.

approved.no_dollar_limits: Nick Oct 27 2026: remove $ caps; stop on losing streaks; stops strict at a %
approved.streak_rule: Nick OK Oct 27 2026: 2 losses in a row = A only + 10 min cooldown; 3 in a row = stop for the day
approved.window_stops: Nick Oct 27 2026: morning 20% (hard cap), midday 12%, afternoon 10%; 20% stays the all-in ceiling
approved.delta_040_055: Nick Oct 27 2026: Claude recommends |delta| 0.40-0.55, aim 0.45 (closer to ATM for tighter stops); Nick OK

per_trade_cap.note: Nick Oct 27: no dollar limits. Risk control = strict 20% stop + losing-streak stops.

session.broker_note: Robinhood may start closing at-risk expiring positions at 3:30 PM ET; all-out 15:25 sits before it.

exit_profile.name: trail_v2
exit_profile.at_breakeven: stop to fill (gross breakeven; net can be a few cents negative)
exit_profile.at_t1_qty2: sell 1, stop on rest to fill x be
exit_profile.at_t1_qty1: hold, stop to fill x be
exit_profile.after_t1: underlying trail: exit on 1m close beyond the last confirmed 1m swing (higher low for calls, lower high for puts)

data.fallback: Yahoo/Alpaca shown as FALLBACK, never used for simulated fills

zone.note: level tolerance = max(3 ticks, 0.15 x ATR(14) of the decision bars)

afternoon.note: 14:00 kept as the comparison boundary from the old policy, not a proven cutoff

exits.flat_rule: old if-flat timer still applies to trades that are NOT green
exits.note: BE +10% / lock +25%->+10% are versioned starting settings (v3), not proven optimal

research.note: separate ledger; per-trade protections and quotes still required

early_entry.note: enter on the cross close only when the trend is clearly strong; otherwise wait for the VWAP retest

optional_filters.note: research toggles, logged per candidate; all off in main

evaluation.name: v3 forward paper test
evaluation.frozen: no rule or threshold changes during the test; any change starts a new test with a new policy version
evaluation.primary: main paper net expectancy per closed trade after modeled costs, with its 95% bootstrap interval
pass_requires_all: at least 10 complete valid sessions (Schwab live, no outage over 15 min in RTH)
at least 20 closed main-paper trades, otherwise the result is 'not enough trades' (extend the test)
net expectancy > 0 and the bootstrap interval's lower bound reported (not required > 0 at this size)
profit factor >= 1.2 and max drawdown under 3x the average loss
no rule violations: every exit matches its rule, no duplicate ideas, no fills on non-executable data
compare: main paper vs old rules on the same sessions
each change separately where the candidates table allows
evaluation.never: a pass does not authorize real-money automation or larger size; Nick decides

research_variants.note: v3.1 research variants. Each runs in its own paper ledger with its own version; main paper (policy 2026-10-29.v3) is unchanged and frozen for the forward test.

exit31.why: same entries as research, exits that let winners run: no stall/momentum exit before T1, 15-min if-flat, runner trails swing/VWAP to 15:25

noise.why: Zarattini/Aziz/Barbon noise-area momentum (SPY shares, 2007-2024), tested here with options

inplay.why: Zarattini/Barbon/Aziz 5-minute ORB on stocks in play (shares, 2016-2023), tested here with options

gated.why: the research entries, only when the anti-chasing entry gate says ENTRY CONDITIONS MET (rejections recorded)

entry_gate.note: STARTING HYPOTHESES for paper testing, not validated values. min_rr null = the v3 minimum reward/risk. ATR = 5-minute ATR(14) on regular-session bars.

options_hours.note: Cboe RTH 9:30-16:00 ET; designated ETF classes to 16:15; half days 13:00/13:15. Check Cboe's designated list. No simulated fills in GTH/Curb.
